title: Reimagining Data Work: Participatory Annotation Workshops as Feminist Practice

bias_targets.methodology: Participatory data annotation workshops where feminist activists and journalists co-create a taxonomy and manually label news articles about gender-related violence for harmful reporting practices like victim-blaming, excusing perpetrators, and misgendering.

Iterative refinement of the annotation taxonomy through group discussions to capture class-based 'othering', occupational stigmatization (e.g., sex workers), and differential media portrayals of victims and perpetrators based on wealth and social status.

Cross-cultural qualitative analysis and collaborative annotation to identify how news reports stigmatize specific communities and construct an 'other' using culturally specific geographic and contextual markers (e.g., associating specific weapons with precarious neighborhoods).
